Reference image 4 is the main character: keep exactly its head, face, colors, markings, body proportions; change only pose, action and expression. TOP PANEL: a young man in a plain shirt stands at an open front door, arms crossed, looking at a plain wristwatch on his wrist, waiting impatiently, tapping one foot; the main character runs toward him from the left carrying one plain cardboard box, ears back with hurry. BOTTOM PANEL: a quiet plain room at dusk: an acoustic guitar leans against an empty plain chair, nobody is in the room, the chair is turned toward the window; soft grey shadows. The flame on the tip of the main character's tail burns bright. LAYOUT: both panels the same size; the man and the main character whole in the top panel; the guitar and the empty chair whole and centred in the bottom panel; the watch face is plain without numbers; no letters or numbers anywhere. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted. Colours: black ink and soft grey washes on cream paper. The only warm colours in the picture are the main character's orange tail flame and cheek marks; every other object — envelopes, paper, furniture, floors, walls — is ink and grey, never brown, beige or orange. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
